language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin messages. auto: follows the Claude Code language setting, then the system locale.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: JEV decides; off: disabled; explicit: only what is forced

agentScope.title: Agent scope
agentScope.description: builtin: only Claude Code's own agents; all: those, your .claude/agents and the plugins' agents. Agents other than general-purpose, Explore and claude keep their own type and get only the model and the effort.

agentHints.title: Agent hints
agentHints.description: Optional. Short text JEV reads beside an agent's name, as name=text pairs split by |. Empty: the agent's own description, cut to 120 characters.

compareModel.title: Compare model
compareModel.description: Model the status line compares the routed cost against. auto: the model of your session.

statusStyle.title: Status line style
statusStyle.description: nerd: Nerd Font icons (needs a Nerd Font in the terminal); plain: text only.

showStatus.title: Show status line
showStatus.description: Draw the JEV status line. Off: the savings stay in the plugin state for another plugin to draw.

maxModel.title: Max model
maxModel.description: The strongest model JEV may pick for a subagent.

maxEffort.title: Max effort
maxEffort.description: The highest effort JEV may pick for subagents, and the cap on your own prompts' effort (unless mode=off).

mainEffort.title: Main prompt effort
mainEffort.description: JEV sets the effort of your own prompts (the session model stays). Adds a JEV call before each prompt.

multiModel.title: Multi-model
multiModel.description: A second, stronger model reviews hard tasks JEV is unsure about.

typesafeApiKey.title: JEV API key (TypeSafe or OpenRouter)
typesafeApiKey.description: TypeSafe key, or an OpenRouter key with the OpenRouter endpoint. Kept in the system secure storage (Keychain on macOS). Empty: uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY or JEV_API_KEY from the environment.

jevEndpoint.title: JEV endpoint
jevEndpoint.description: System One API URL (https). OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/systemone
